title: Spectral features and bearing-fault detection
scenario: Corvane's pumps run 6205-class bearings at 29.5 Hz with 20 kHz accelerometers. The gateway needs a feature module per 2-second window: time-domain health numbers, Welch band energies, and an outer/inner race early warning from the envelope spectrum that never fires on healthy pumps.
task: Time-domain AC features: RMS, peak, crest factor, kurtosis
Welch PSD, band energies and sub-bin dominant frequency
Bearing defect frequencies from geometry (BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF)
Envelope spectrum and a harmonic-confirmed fault detector
acceptance: Known-answer tests on synthetic signals pass (kurtosis, band power, sub-bin frequency, identities)
Healthy captures never flagged; outer, inner and a weak outer fault found and labelled
Input validation incl. band above Nyquist
ANSWER.md explains the envelope in plain words

practices.label: Week 2 Mon - sampling, Nyquist and the FFT
Week 2 Tue - windowing, leakage and Welch PSD
Week 2 Thu - features and bearing defect frequencies
